targets.rawSql:
SELECT hour AS time, series, sum(cnt) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date),' ',if(time='','00:00:00',time)))) AS hour, 'INPUT' AS series, count() AS cnt FROM smf.smf_14 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date),' ',if(time='','00:00:00',time)))) AS hour, 'OUTPUT' AS series, count() AS cnt FROM smf.smf_15 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date),' ',if(time='','00:00:00',time)))) AS hour, 'SCRATCH' AS series, count() AS cnt FROM smf.smf_17 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY hour
) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: INPUT vs OUTPUT vs SCRATCH

targets.rawSql:
SELECT direction, sum(c) AS events FROM (
  SELECT 'INPUT' AS direction, count() AS c FROM smf.smf_14 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'OUTPUT' AS direction, count() AS c FROM smf.smf_15 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'SCRATCH' AS direction, count() AS c FROM smf.smf_17 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
) GROUP BY direction ORDER BY events DESC

panels.description: Event counts by SMF type (not a misleading single-slice pie).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT direction, job_name,
  if(dsname = '' OR match(dsname, '^[\\x00-\\x1f\\x7f-\\x9f\\x{fffd}?]+$'), concat('(no dsname) ', volser), dsname) AS dsname_display,
  if(dsname = '' OR match(dsname, '^[\\x00-\\x1f\\x7f-\\x9f\\x{fffd}?]+$'), '', dsname) AS dsname,
  volser, sum(rows) AS rows, sum(excp) AS excp
FROM (
  SELECT 'INPUT' AS direction, job_name, trim(BOTH ' ' FROM dsname) AS dsname, volser_1 AS volser, count() AS rows, sum(toUInt64OrZero(excp_count)) AS excp
  FROM smf.smf_14 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY job_name, dsname, volser
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'OUTPUT' AS direction, job_name, trim(BOTH ' ' FROM dsname) AS dsname, volser_1 AS volser, count() AS rows, sum(toUInt64OrZero(excp_count)) AS excp
  FROM smf.smf_15 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY job_name, dsname, volser
)
GROUP BY direction, job_name, dsname_display, dsname, volser
ORDER BY rows DESC LIMIT 60
